meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 审核并指导GeoPandas空间数据处理流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用GeoPandas处理地理空间数据并需要质量保障。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and guide GeoPandas spatial data workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with GeoPandas for geospatial data and need quality assurance.

howto.what: 当请求用 GeoPandas 处理地理空间向量数据时，Claude 依据技能给出读写各格式（如 shapefile、GeoJSON、GeoPackage）、几何操作、空间连接、绘图等示例，并提醒检查 CRS 和最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你的请求涉及读取/写入或分析向量地理数据（如 shapefile、GeoJSON、GeoPackage），或要求做空间连接、叠加分析、缓冲区分析等任务时触发。

say.text: 用 GeoPandas 读 shapefile，检查 CRS 并转成 3857
say.note: Claude 会给出读取和重投影代码

say.text: 对这两个 GeoDataFrame 做空间连接，统计每个多边形内的点数
say.note: Claude 会展示 sjoin 用法

say.text: 用 GeoPandas 生成 choropleth 地图并保存为 HTML
say.note: Claude 会提供绘图和导出代码

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude will provide GeoPandas code examples for reading/writing vector data, geometric operations, spatial joins, overlays, plotting, and CRS best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the request involves reading, writing, or analyzing vector geospatial data (e.g., Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage), or tasks like spatial joins, overlays, or buffer analysis.

say_en.text: Read this shapefile with GeoPandas, check the CRS, and reproject to EPSG:3857
say_en.note: Claude will provide read and reprojection code.

say_en.text: Do a spatial join on these two GeoDataFrames and count points per polygon
Make a choropleth map with GeoPandas and save it as an HTML file
say_en.note: Claude will show plotting and export code.
